notes: Visualizer: new 'Smart' palette samples the captured tab's video frame and pulls 2-3 dominant colors out, then paints any visualizer style (Bars / Mirror / Wave / Circle) in those colors. Smooth 0.4s interpolation between samples (every 600ms) so colors flow with the music. Audio analysis works exactly as before; the video track is just kept alive for color sampling and stays hidden — nothing of the tab UI is shown.
